editorial:
Imagine being sixteen and feeling so trapped by your rich father and his young new wife that you start working at a strip club just to get some freedom. That is exactly where you meet Nina, a rebellious ballet student who is way more mature than she should be. Then there is Alex, a thirty-year-old architect who is totally caught off guard when he sees her perform. The movie gets interesting when Alex is hired to work on her school, bringing these two very different worlds together. You will feel the tension as they try to navigate a romance that feels wrong to everyone else but feels right to them.

You will notice that the movie focuses a lot on the emotional pull between the two leads, though the pacing can feel a bit slow in the middle. The acting is solid, and it really makes you wonder if love can actually beat social rules. If you enjoy dramas that make you feel a bit uneasy but keep you guessing, you should definitely give this one a try. It looks great if you can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but renting it on Apple TV is also a quick way to see it. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical shelf is a smart move.
endingExplained: The story wraps up with a lot of tension as the secret relationship finally comes out. Both Nina and Alex have to face the anger of their families and the judgment of the people around them. In the end, they realize that their age gap and the way they met create too many problems to ignore. They have to make a hard choice about whether to stay together or grow apart to find a healthier path in life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves taboo romances and emotional character studies.
